source: FIGURES.md pass, September 2026, run on sources 4 to 6 only. Sources 1 to 3 (Ahrefs matching terms on 'acid house artists', also_talk_about, People Also Ask on founder questions) were not run: the owner asked for no new Ahrefs calls (2026-09-22). The owner-supplied People Also Ask did carry 'Who is considered the father of acid house?' and 'Was acid house invented in India?', which is source 3 for Phuture and Charanjit Singh.
note: Source 4, the consensus lists: Mixmag 'The history of acid house in 100 tracks', Clash '7 of the best acid house classics', DJ Pierre's own list (RBMA 2012, DMY). Source 5, the originators: Wikipedia 'Acid house', 'Acid Tracks', 'Second Summer of Love', 'We Call It Acieed', 'Voodoo Ray', 'Synthesizing: Ten Ragas to a Disco Beat', and DJ Pierre's RBMA account. Source 6, the catalogue: 688 of 62,877 sets tagged acid; most frequent artists Love Letters and Mike Servito (22), Abby Echiverri (19), X-Coast (11), DJ Pierre (7), A Guy Called Gerald (7), Helena Hauff (6). Every embed below was checked by YouTube oEmbed on 2026-09-22 and comes from the label's, the artist's or the auto-generated Topic channel, except the Charanjit Singh upload, which is from Bombay Connection, the label that reissued the album.
